raw.query: SELECT family, predictor, resolution, wape FROM forecast_eval WHERE signal='images' AND horizon_h=1 AND is_valid=true ORDER BY resolution, wape
raw.observed: 1min WAPE spread 0.5153–0.618 (best to worst ~20%; top-6 cluster 0.5153–0.5399 ~4.8%); 15s spread 0.6374–0.9917 (toto/cov vs holt_winters ~56%; kalman 0.8111 vs toto 0.6374 ~27%)
raw.claimed: Inter-model margins are small enough that engineering considerations can drive the choice
raw.evidence: Top models cluster tightly only at 1min (≤5% spread) but at 15s the spread reaches ~27–56%, so 'margins are small' is resolution-dependent and not universal
raw.fix: Qualify the claim to the coarse (1min) resolution / leading-model tier; do not assert uniformly small inter-model margins across all resolutions and models
